ulg.text: The Metathran are an army Urza creates from genetic stock gathered around the world and infused with magic, though Barrin contests his methods and researchers quit.
Thaddeus and Agnate are awoken first to command the troops, and the Metathran help win the battles of Koilos and the Stronghold.
The Dominarians win thanks to the Weatherlight crew, but the Metathran race dies out with the war.

uds.text: Urza constructs the Metathran as an army of sorcery and power to resist Yawgmoth's coming invasion and the Rath overlay.

They are conceived, birthed and nurtured by an integrated system of machines, and Urza creates them in the project's second phase amid controversy, as Barrin contests his methods and some researchers quit.
